items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: I think Sam Morgan had one of the nicest tones of any of the Negroes

ctx.x: Was Sam loud or soft or like that? No, he had a nice tone
I think Sam Morgan had one of the nicest tones of any of the Negroes And he knew what he was playing He played nice arrangements He played nice arrangements Wasn't no bell or stuff All nice stuff
Did he uh... Read those arrangements? No, no, no Head arrangements
